response.sql: WITH o AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_avg FROM Laboratory) SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(l.RBC) AS avg_rbc, AVG(l.GOT) - o.overall_avg AS got_diff FROM Laboratory l CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.ID, o.overall_avg ORDER BY (AVG(l.GOT) - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, got_diff DESC LIMIT 10
